entries.198d75e2547c6714: Finished semiconductors are built into a variety of electronic devices and reach the world. In everything from smartphones, personal computers, home appliances and automobiles to satellites, they play the role of storing and processing information.
entries.1e5fbf469c209ebe: This is the process of building electronic circuits on a wafer. Treatments such as exposure and development, which transfer the circuit pattern, and etching, which removes parts of a film, are repeated from dozens to hundreds of times to form the wiring, after which the wafer is inspected, while still a wafer, to check that electricity flows correctly. It may also be carried out by companies that do no design and only undertake manufacturing (foundries).

entries.77fa7565d59cd4da: These include silicon wafers, which form the base for building circuits; components and materials such as substrates, lead frames and resin used in packages; and raw materials such as helium and noble gases. Because the number of processes is very large, many materials are used, and their quality directly affects the performance of semiconductors.
entries.b68601a856a2d049: [[term:semiconductor|Semiconductors]] are materials that sometimes conduct electricity and sometimes do not, and the electronic components made from them. They store and process information and are built into all kinds of electronic devices, from smartphones to automobiles. Making a semiconductor involves circuit design, the [[term:front-end-process|front-end process]] of building circuits on a [[term:wafer|wafer]], and the [[term:back-end-process|back-end process]] of cutting the wafer into chips and packaging them, and it relies on many [[term:semiconductor-manufacturing-equipment|manufacturing equipment]] types and materials. As competition in the global market has intensified, the division of labor has advanced, and today companies with different strengths, such as companies that only design, companies that only undertake manufacturing, and companies that make equipment and materials, are connected across national borders.
entries.bfc56d51c7d48a98: Circuits that deliver the required performance, and their arrangement (layout), are designed with dedicated design tools, and their operation is verified.
entries.d0ddd92d1882dc94: Finished semiconductors are built into a variety of electronic devices and reach the world.
entries.d8a204fa378c2632: Circuits that deliver the required performance, and their arrangement (layout), are designed with dedicated design tools, and their operation is verified. The photomasks used to transfer the circuit patterns onto wafers are designed as well. Some companies have no factories and concentrate on design, leaving manufacturing to outside firms (fabless companies).
entries.e0f1c9fa36ab2997: Equipment used in the front-end and back-end processes. There are many types, including deposition equipment that forms films, exposure equipment that transfers circuit patterns, etching equipment that removes parts of a film, dicing equipment that cuts wafers into chips, molding equipment that encloses chips in resin, and inspection equipment. Specifications are often adjusted in detail to suit the semiconductor being made, and there are almost no identical products.
entries.e99305fb619d7ba0: The wafer is cut into chips, each chip is attached to a lead frame and connected with metal wires, and it is sealed and packaged with resin or similar materials. Finally, appearance and electrical characteristics are inspected, and defective products are removed. Some companies specialize in undertaking assembly and inspection.
